messages:
maya: Quick review of the roles panel prototype. Plan: collapse the legend into a compact pill, move the SSO toggle into the security row, and add a lightweight 'jump to audit' affordance on role changes. Helps reduce visual noise on narrow screens. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/roles-proto
lucas: Compact legend makes sense but worried about discoverability. Can we show it on first-run or surface a tooltip? :thinking:
anya: Maybe a tiny '?' icon next to 'Roles' that opens the legend inline (not a drawer). That keeps screen space and is keyboard accessible.
maya: Proposal: collapsed pill with aria-expanded and an inline panel for keyboard users. Pill label: 'Permissions legend'. Considering shorter role labels: 'Read / Run / Admin' instead of full sentences.
samir: Short labels OK, but include a verbose aria-label for screen readers: "Permissions legend. Read: can view resources; Run: can execute jobs; Admin: full control."
tess: SSO toggle copy: product prefers 'Require SSO' over 'Enforce SSO' to avoid sounding punitive. Security likes 'Require SSO'.
maya: In the prototype the toggle reads 'Require SSO for this org' with a help link and a small staged-SSO state note. Screenshot: https://img.hosting.example/ssotoggle.png
lucas: Microcopy: change CTA from 'Send invite' to 'Invite member' to match bulk invites and empty-state CTAs.
anya: Accessibility nits: current blue role-pill text at 12px fails contrast. Need to hit 4.5:1. Also keyboard focus ring missing — currently only hover styles.
maya: I'll update color tokens and add focus styles. Audit nav: instead of a chevron to open audit drawer, propose a small 'jump' button (eye icon) next to changed attributes that opens the audit panel scrolled to that event.
samir: Nice. Could the jump also pre-filter audit to role changes (?event=role_change) so panel highlights relevant entries?
tess: Make sure the jump is keyboard tabbable and has aria-label 'Jump to audit entry for this role change' — hover-only is inaccessible.
lucas: Implementation note: rendering a button per row might be heavy. Suggest lazy-render on hover/focus or a single floating action that repositions.
maya: We'll lazy-render and fallback to drawer action if JS absent. Copy options to push: ['Permissions legend','Invite member','Require SSO for this org','Jump to audit entry']. I'll update Figma and post an accessibility checklist.
release-bot: prototype-deploy: roles-panel-v2 updated at 1968512600 — review link: https://deploys.example/roles-panel-v2
anya: Also consider a keyboard shortcut hint (g then a) to open the audit panel for power users — track in backlog, not blocking launch.
maya: Thanks all, I'll iterate and post updates + checklist here. :thumbsup:
